rationale: The candidate preserves the title, yield, all measured ingredients, the separate unmeasured coating butter and sugar, all five setup obligations, every operation and dependency, the meringue completion cue, the bake temperature and duration, and the immediate-service final output. The allocation ambiguity is resolved by explicitly distinguishing coating materials from the measured butter and sugar and by naming the custard, meringue, and 30 g butter as fold inputs.
